training_data: 500 generated invoices, no real invoices and no labelled fraud examples.
algorithm: IsolationForest on log1p(total) and item count
limitations: Anomaly is not fraud. No fraud accuracy or business ROI is measured.
Bundled model is illustrative. Retrain with representative single-currency invoice history before actual use.
Input is English labelled plain text, not OCR or PDF parsing. Optional LLM extraction needs review.
Human approval records a decision only; no money is moved.
